_comment: Operator inventory for the S-plane recovery loop. This is configuration (what the operator has provisioned), not measurement. Identities are IEEE 1588 clockIdentity values derived by linuxptp from each node's first interface MAC (EUI-48 -> EUI-64 with fffe insertion).
_operator_state_comment: Per-run operator state (maintenance window open, planned replacement BC ticket) is supplied separately in state.json by the scenario driver, exactly as context.json supplied it in the 168-run campaign.
_port_naming: Bridge-port names are the root-namespace ends of each veth: topology.sh names them p-<ifname> (p-v-bc-dn, p-v-ru1..3); devices added by run_one.py are named p-<ifname without 'v-'> (p-bcs-dn, p-bc2-dn, p-rogue, p-rbc-dn).
